name: Salahuddin Ahmed
role: BNP standing committee member, MP, and Home Affairs Minister
contribution: A senior BNP leader who won Cox’s Bazar-1 in the 2026 parliamentary election and entered the new government as Minister for Home Affairs.
context: Salahuddin Ahmed has served in BNP’s National Standing Committee and was a senior public voice during the 2025–2026 election transition. In the 12 February 2026 election, he won the Cox’s Bazar-1 seat, covering Chakaria and Pekua, before taking a cabinet role.
impact: His movement from senior party leadership and election campaigning into the Home Affairs Ministry made him a visible link between BNP’s electoral organization and the new government’s internal-security and public-order portfolio.
highlight: BNP leader who won Cox’s Bazar-1 and became Home Affairs Minister in 2026.
seoTitle: Salahuddin Ahmed: BNP Leader and Home Affairs Minister
seoDescription: Learn about Salahuddin Ahmed, BNP standing committee member, Cox’s Bazar-1 MP, and Home Affairs Minister after Bangladesh’s 2026 parliamentary election.
shortAnswer: Salahuddin Ahmed is a senior BNP leader who won Cox’s Bazar-1 in 2026 and became Bangladesh’s Home Affairs Minister.

faq.question: Which constituency did Salahuddin Ahmed win in 2026?
faq.answer: He won Cox’s Bazar-1, the constituency covering Chakaria and Pekua, as a BNP candidate.

faq.question: What government role did Salahuddin Ahmed take after the 2026 election?
faq.answer: He became Bangladesh’s Minister for Home Affairs while continuing as a BNP National Standing Committee member.
